evidence.finding: Existing graph-analysis owner dispatches to Neo4j GDS by default or the explicitly selected cuGraph adapter; it owns analysis orchestration, not canonical source/symbol identity.
cuGraph persists derived graph-analysis run/metric records through the existing Postgres projection tables; no identity ownership is introduced.
Records Neo4j GDS and cuGraph as graph-analysis backends; its status is used as owner classification, not as proof of current runtime health.

focusedTests.scope: Mocked/unit adapter and dispatch behavior only; not live Neo4j/cuGraph parity or runtime availability.

followUp: GDS-04 remains open until Neo4j GDS and optional cuGraph are compared on the same admitted graph snapshot with parity and runtime receipts.
